key: e:technical reference guide for roads and other vehicle operating areas
synopsis: NSW Resources Regulator guidance on vehicle interaction controls in mines includes a draft Technical Reference Guide, alongside a July 2022 compliance report, a September 2023 discussion paper and a May 2025 fact sheet [f2785]. Chapter 3 identifies the tripartite Adverse Vehicle Interaction Advisory Committee as developing the guide for roads and other vehicle operating areas, while the glossary attributes development more broadly to the regulator [f2265, f15538]. The guide remains a draft, and the regulator’s guidance prescribes no testing requirements, leaving a gap for validation acceptance planning [f2787].

relations.note: Identifies the tripartite committee developing the guide and its operating-area scope.
Places the draft guide within the regulator’s dated suite of mine vehicle-interaction guidance.
Confirms continuing draft status and identifies the absence of prescribed testing requirements.
